item.title: "Her job is going to be as a palliative care doctor who slides Xbox gently into the night" - original Xbox co-creator thinks Microsoft's reshuffle is all about AI
item.description: Seamus Blackley, one of the co-creators of the original Xbox, has interpreted Microsoft's recent Xbox leadership shuffle as a sign the business is being "sunsetted". The appointment of Asha Sharma, he thinks, is "as a palliative care doctor who slides Xbox gently into the night". Read more

item.title: Evo is getting five more regional events and a new world championship: here's what's good, what's bad, and what matters
item.description: Evo - the largest fighting game tournament series - announced future plans to expand across the world with five new regional tournaments, a new World Championship, and plans to support local communities in the proximity of these new events. Read more

item.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie may still have an unannounced character popping up on its release
item.description: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is only a matter of months from release, and it now seems an unannounced character may play a key role in the upcoming sequel thanks to a slight slip up by one UK cinema chain. Read more

item.title: There's a new Overwatch game in development
item.description: Blizzard has announced a new mobile Overwatch game called Overwatch Rush. It's a top-down reinterpretation of the hero shooter built especially for mobile players and it's in development at Blizzard, made by a team separate from the Overwatch team, Blizzard said in a blog post. Read more

item.title: The future of Xbox is vague and contradictory, with just a glimmer of hope
item.description: So Phil Spencer is gone. So too is Sarah Bond who, per some reports, had as much if not more influence over strategy than Spencer in recent years. Up comes Matt Booty, who was already part of the main leadership trio and is now chief content officer, broadly overseeing Xbox's internal studios and the games they make. And in comes Asha Sharma. Read more

item.title: Here are the PC specs for Death Stranding 2: On the Beach
item.description: PC players, get ready for your mind to be melted (metaphorically speaking) in all manner of ways. Hideo Kojima's ever so unusual Death Stranding sequel - known as On the Beach - is soon going to make its PC debut, and so of course the team has now shared those all important specs you will need to get the best experience. Read more

item.title: Prototype and The Simpsons: Hit & Run developer Radical Entertainment is seemingly back, and fan speculation is already running rampant
item.description: The two Prototype games, The Incredible Hulk: Ultimate Destruction, and The Simpsons: Hit & Run were all great open-world games before open-world games became a thing, and they all have one thing in common: Radical Entertainment was their developer. Now, after being shut down by Activision over a decade ago, the studio seems to have returned. Read more

item.title: The first Horizon Hunters Gathering closed beta is happening this weekend and just as Marathon has its own "server slam" test
item.description: Horizon Hunters Gathering wasn't exactly what we were expecting when we first heard about Guerilla Games tackling an online multiplayer Horizon game for Sony, but the PS5 and PC "tactical co-op" title certainly looks interesting to enough to warrant a closer look. Now, it appears the first closed beta test is about to happen, and its timing is a bit funny. Read more

item.title: "It needed a little bit of a rework" - Battlefield 6 producer speaks on shooter's unloved in-game unlocks
item.description: Battlefield 6's producer Alexia Christofi has spoken about the game's meta-progression overhaul, which needed a rework following player-feedback shortly after the game's launch. Read more

item.title: PS5 exclusive Marvel's Wolverine claws its way to a surprisingly early autumn release date
item.description: Marvel's Wolverine finally has a release date, and good news: it's coming out later this year. Read more
